fields.Name: T072 - Bulk Add Records to List
fields.Description: Selects multiple grid rows and opens the bulk Add-to-List dialog, verifying multi-record selection + bulk action.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Products' entity grid — type 'Products' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click it (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Products). Select MULTIPLE rows using the row checkboxes at the left of the grid (click the checkbox on a few rows, or the header checkbox to select the whole page). Then click the 'Add to List' button in the grid toolbar (it enables once rows are selected). Verify a bulk 'Add N Records to List' dialog opens — it shows a list search box, a 'New' / 'Create List' option, and list selection (or a 'No lists yet' empty state with a Create List button). Seeing the bulk add-to-list dialog open is success — you do NOT need to finish adding. No error. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Multiple grid rows were selected via the row checkboxes
Clicking 'Add to List' opened a bulk 'Add N Records to List' dialog (list search / Create List / list selection or empty state)
No error messages or crash pages
